entityDescription:
BookingClinic.com is a smart telemedicine and booking platform that connects Patients with Doctors and Clinics around the world, offering virtual medical consultation with your preferred Doctor and online booking engineer to Find, Compare & Book a treatment or an operation at a Clinic worldwide, fostering quality and accessibility in patient’s choice.
 
BookingClinic.com aims to serve the patients who need to consult a doctor and/or have a treatment or an operation. A friendly, trustful online tool to virtually meet a Doctor (via videocall), receive trustworthy medical consultation and finally Find, Compare and Book the best Clinic with the Doctor of choice at the Best Price. Patients have a 24/7 access to transparent info and data on medical experience, hospitality info, customer satisfaction ratings and total costs. Online videocall is offered, upgrading customer’s experience and trust. Clinics can promote their services worldwide, use a new digital channel to attract patients from new markets (medical tourism) and improve their services by receiving crucial feedback from patients. The platform enables them to penetrate the online Health e-market. Insurance companies can also benefit from reduced costs and upgraded customer experience.
National emergency of COVID-19 mobilized the company to offer its services, initially for Greece, for the greater good of all. BookingClinic in cooperation with the humanitarian organisation “Medecins Du Monde” will support the call “#DigitalSolidarityGR” offering telemedicine medical consultation for covid-19 free of charge, in order to connect patients to medical centers, according to EODY protocols. The objective is via a virtual visit to the doctor to be able to consult patients on covid-19 and identify cases that need to be tested or treated for covid-19 so they can be directed to the clinics of the National Health System. This initiative will generate noteworthy traction on the platform and enhance repute thus enabling organic growth and revenue boost.

The company’s main areas of activity are worldwide distribution, services and development of specific software solutions based on new advanced, efficient algorithms. A special feature of our different software tools is the good interaction between them. In the mentioned industrial sectors, fleXstructures has gained comprehensive expert know-how and has therefore an excellent reputation. Besides sales and distribution activities, the company renders consulting services, carries out engineering as well as research projects and software trainings. entityDescription:
The “New technologies for Life” Technical Vocational School [Istituto Tecnico Superiore (ITS) “Nuove tecnologie per la Vita” was created to train highly specialized professional figures in a strategic sector of the regional economy, the Life Sciences. The objective of the ITS, which operates throughout the entire Tuscany region, is to fulfill the demand of companies with new high-level technical and technological expertise in a sector that sees Tuscany among the top three Italian regions in terms of the presence of companies and employees as well as turnover.
The “New technologies for Life” ITS Foundation, specifically, is led by the ITIS “Sarrocchi” in Siena and counts 21 partners including the Toscana Life Sciences Foundation (coordinator), the Tuscan Universities of Siena, Pisa and Florence, the provinces of Siena and Pisa, the municipality of Siena, the metropolitan city of Florence, the “Cellini” Institute of Florence, the industrial associations of Florence and southern Tuscany, and the training agencies Toscana Formazione, ASEV, Confindustria Toscana Servizi and Pon-Tech. Several leading companies in the Tuscan chemical, pharmaceutical and biomedical sector are among the companies directly involved in the Foundation and strategic for the training outcomes of the Technical Vocational School: GSK, Menarini, Kedrion, Corima, and Deka Mela.
VITA Foundation manages two-year ministerial courses with a diploma of Higher Technician, 5th level EQF, for the Life Sciences and ICT area, with the following specializations:
· Superior technician for research and development of biotechnology-based products and processes.
· Superior technician for the quality system of biotechnology-based products and processes.
· Superior technician for the production of diagnostic, therapeutic and rehabilitative equipment and devices.
· Superior technician for methods and technologies for the development of software systems.
Vita Foundation is also accredited to the MIUR for the training of trainers, thus characterizing even more an important role in the transfer of skills and knowledge in the productive field.
Since July 2017 it has been accredited to the Region of Tuscany, according to the provisions of the Council Resolution n.1407/2016 and subsequent amendments, as an accredited and recognized training agency and since August 2018 it has obtained the ISO9001/2015 Quality Certification.
It participates as an affiliate member of the highly specialized Competence Center Advanced Robotics and enabling digital TEchnologies & Systems 4.0 - ARTES 4.0, MISE project.

Khymeia is an Italian Company focused on innovative high-end technology medical products and services for rehabilitation (website: www.khymeia.com).
Khymeia has developed the VRRS Virtual Reality Rehabilitation System, an innovative platform for rehabilitation and tele-rehabilitation, based on virtual reality, biofeedback, and exergaming technologies. Originally devised in collaboration with Boston MIT Massachusetts Institute of Technology, the system is now completely developed, produced and marketed by Khymeia. Khymeia also developed the OAK Elderly Care system, a dedicated ecosystem for the evaluation and the treatment of fall risk, and the Neurowave system, an innovative device for the clinical and electrophysiological evaluation and treatment of patients suffering from severe disorders of consciousness (Vegetative and minimally conscious states). Khymeia develops its products in close collaboration with key clinical and research partners and collaborates with the large majority of IRCCSs in Italy. IRCCS stands for Istituto di Ricovero e Cura a Carattere Scientifico) and identifies the Hospitals (both private and public) that manage both clinical as well as research activities; they represent the excellence of the Italian National Health System.
 
The range of rehabilitation applications targeted by the VRRS and OAK methodologies is fairly wide. Originally conceived for neurological rehabilitation in stroke patients, after many years of development and clinical trials VRRS is now a versatile platform that for neurological rehabilitation (upper limb, lower limb, fine hand movements, facial movements, spine tract) in patients suffering from Stroke, Traumatic Brain Injury, Parkinson's Disease, Neglect, Multiple Sclerosis and other neurological conditions, supporting clinical rehabilitation strategies in every stage of the recovery of the patient. VRRS now includes also modules for cognitive, logaoedic, postural, musculoskeletal, sportive, and respiratory rehabilitation. The OAK system, devised for evaluation and treatment of postural stability, is now used as a multidisciplinary tool to support postural rehabilitation for neurological and orthopaedic patients.
 
Khymeia has recently developed a fully functional cloud-based architecture for telerehabilitation, including clinical control stations, devices for patients at home, and web-based applications. Such architecture allows for several services: audiovideconference services, telecontrol services, remote settings of prescriptions of clinically based exercises to be conducted with simple wearable devices, easily adaptable to patient needs and capabilities, and centralized collection of results. The architecture is the backbone of the on-going project “Development and implementation of an Italian Network of Tele-neuro-rehabilitation for continuity of care“ of the Italian Ministry of Health, involving the Italian Neuroscience IRCCS Network. 
 
The VRRS represents the world's most innovative and tested rehabilitation system based on virtual reality technology, whose effectiveness has been accredited by specific international publications on the matter. 
Following 10 years of development and clinical trials, many prestigious international scientific publications have been released. For the full list of relevant publication regarding the usage and the clinical validation of the VRRS Khymeia systems for neuromotor, orthopaedic, cognitive and speech-related rehabilitation, comprehensive of telerehabilitation applications, please refer to: www.khymeia.com/en/validation.

entityDescription:
The Department of Earth and Environmental Sciences (DISAT) includes a staff of about 100 people of which about 70 form the scientific permanent staff (professors and researchers) plus 25 units of technical staff supporting research activities in the lab and in the field.
Research activities at the Department of Earth and Environmental Sciences (DISAT) focus on environmental evolution and on the dynamics of planet Earth. Researchers, teachers and technicians belong to diverse disciplines, including geology, chemistry, biology and physics.Our main goals are to:
- study the environment as an interactive system characterized by natural, human and technological components and their mutual relationships;
- analyse with state-of-the-art techniques the composition, history, characteristics and behaviour of a range of materials, to understand the processes controlling the dynamic evolution of the Earth’s surface, on continents and oceans, describing their interactions and impact on climatic change.

Activities taking place at DISAT include scientific research in the frame of international and national projects together with applied research in the frame of contracts with companies and other private and public institutions. Most of our research projects are multidisciplinary and involve complex analyses that require a range of different expertise in disparate fields of the physical sciences
A special lab caled GEMMA develops activities in the field of remote sensing by using and colecting data through different platforms.
